why: Both directions are vacuous; the statements use different notions of measure zero. A (universes at 0) is Lemma 9.5.2 and five companion facts for an abstract null-set system G : SheetNullSets S, whose field isNull_transfer (two sheets of S induce the same null sets on their intersection) carries the content of the lemma, plus the mixed-dimension counterexample to that field. B uses a concrete notion, IsLocNullB: locally n-dimensional Hausdorff-null in every chart of the object M-polyfold. This is a property of the set alone, not of the sheet. Hence B holds outright (B_holds) by the covering argument: on U(z), supp Θ = ⋃ Mᵢ; take IsLocNullB's open set at z for z ∈ Mᵢ and U(z) ∖ Mᵢ (open, since the inclusion is proper) otherwise. Tameness, dimension and suitability are not used. A_to_B_of_hyp also derives B through A's isMeasureZeroSuppAll_of_any, using a SheetNullSets built from IsLocNullB on the class GoodSheets: sheets on which locally null subsets are closed under countable unions and which are not null in themselves. Its extra hypothesis is that the sheets of suitable structures are good. That needs local second countability of the sheets (in a non-separable E₀, IsLocNullB is not σ-additive in general) and positive Hausdorff measure of n-dimensional sheets. It fails for sheets of dimension < n, and is not proved. B ⇒ A re-proves A outright (section ReProof).
B_issue: Not a bug, but B's IsLocNullB (n-dimensional Hausdorff outer measure on chart images, localized) is not σ-additive without second countability of the sets measured. So its null sets need not form a σ-ideal on arbitrary sheets. This matters for V9_51, which copies the notion.
overlap: rt_overlap B_to_A: 636 shared project theorems; rt_overlap A_to_B: 618. None of them is banned. They are the infrastructure under the statements: the M-polyfold chart, retract and tangent glue under IsSmoothSubmanifold and HasTameInducedStructure in LocalBranchingStructure / IsSuitableB, the groupoid basics behind OrbitSpace, and the SheetMeasureGeometry/planeNull/graphNull fields under isNull_transfer_mixed_dim's statement. They also include the lemmas used directly: LocalBranchingStructure.mem_supp_iff, isOpen_U_diff_M, SheetNullSets.isNull_of_cover, preimage_π_orbitSupp, isMeasureZero_rn2_iff, lineH_ne_top. rt_check passes on A_to_B, A_to_B_of_hyp and B_to_A; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
